title: The Digital Collection of Taiwan's Fish Otoliths (NMMBA-Fish-Otoliths)

description.en: The LOD dataset of ASCDC_The Digital Collection of Taiwan's Fish Otoliths (NMMBA-Fish-Otoliths) was created by the Academia Sinica Center for Digital Cultures (ASCDC) and based on the metadata from “The Digital Collection of Taiwan's Fish Otoliths” (國立海洋生物博物館台灣耳石典藏計畫) in the “Taiwan Union Catalog” (數位典藏與數位學習聯合目錄, https://catalog.digitalarchives.tw/Organization/List.jsp?CID=57275). Originally, the metadata was established by the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium (NMMBA, 國立海洋生物博物館) in Taiwan (ROC). It provides information on specimens of fish otoliths collected by the NMMBA and can serve as a database for the study of fish species in the coastal waters in and around Taiwan. Containing 1,804 data records and 191,464 triples, the textual content within the LOD dataset is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution (CC 0), while the digitized items are under CC-BY-NC-SA.
